source: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics and OCHA ROAP, via geoBoundaries (gbOpen BGD ADM2-ADM4), CC BY 3.0 IGO. Simplified.

assumptions.Dhaka North: DNCC_Ward_N is drawn on old Dhaka City Corporation ward N (N = 1-20).
assumptions.Dhaka South: DSCC_Ward_N is drawn on old ward 20+N (N <= 16) or 31+N (N >= 17), the old wards numbered in order after Dhaka North's share.
assumptions.Chattogram: CCC_Ward_N is drawn on Chattogram ward N.
assumptions.Gazipur: No public ward shapes; city core area only (Gazipur and Tongi paurashavas).
assumptions.Narayanganj: No public ward shapes; city core area only (Narayanganj and Kadam Rasul paurashavas).
